dedupe_keys.name: 濃飛乗合自動車 濃飛ハス gtfs transit data

description:
濃飛乗合自動車（濃飛バス）: GTFS transit data is a dataset listed in Mobility Database, a catalogue of GTFS and GTFS Realtime transit feeds, published or maintained by 濃飛乗合自動車（濃飛バス）. Public transport schedule data (routes, stops, trips and stop times in the General Transit Feed Specification) for Takayama, Gifu Prefecture, Japan. Coverage: Takayama, Gifu Prefecture, Japan. The Mobility Database lists 3 GTFS schedule feeds for this provider (Takayama, Gifu Prefecture, Japan). The schedule feeds declare these GTFS features: Attributions, Fares V1, Feed Information, Headsigns, Location Types, Route Colors, Shapes, Transfers. At least one feed is marked as published by the operator itself. Note in the listing: 収録路線：一般路線全路線
　特急バスを除く
　乗鞍線・上高地線などの観光路線、高山周遊バスは別データを参照
GTFS-JP ３版対応 It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, accessibility and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-mobility-database-mobilitydata.
